refresh_protocol.pairing_purpose: align the first, second, and third independent QKV refreshes with the first, second, and third independent down refreshes for a planning-only arithmetic sum

refresh_protocol.interpretation: The refresh does not reverse either component's historical production rejection. It supplies admission evidence for a newly implemented and newly measured joint candidate.

post_refresh_future_joint_gates.registration_time: after all six component refresh logs were collected and reviewed
post_refresh_future_joint_gates.applies_to: the future newly implemented palette-v2 joint candidate, not the six component refresh processes
post_refresh_future_joint_gates.interpretation: That numerical comparison is why implementation may begin; it is not evidence that the not-yet-built joint candidate has passed these gates.

launch_amortization_comparison.heuristic_comparison: The palette-v2 component arithmetic is about four times the proportional 64-launch idle heuristic, so palette v2 is the next bounded implementation before a launch-amortization prototype.
launch_amortization_comparison.upper_bound_caveat: 0.613196 ms is an idle upper bound, not guaranteed recoverable launch overhead.
launch_amortization_comparison.heuristic_caveat: The 0.101145732-ms value assumes idle is uniform across 388 launches; no 64-launch removal candidate was implemented or timed, and the heuristic is not additive to the palette-v2 arithmetic sum.

claim_limits: Each logical group's QKV and down components were launched sequentially as independent processes. No log contains a same-process jointly timed QKV-plus-down bundle.

The 0.313080/0.401048/0.490554-ms values are arithmetic sums of independent 48-layer QKV and 53-layer down projections. Their 0.401048-ms median is an implementation-admission statistic, not a measured bundle, production, or end-to-end result.

The +0.30-ms per-process, +0.35-ms three-process median, strict component-round, and future +0.25-ms end-to-end median gates were registered only after reviewing these refresh results. They were not frozen before refresh and must not be described as prospectively passed by the six logs.
The 106.912952 ms/token and 9.35340 token/s values are arithmetic projections from the unchanged 107.314000-ms anchor, not a new formal anchor or achieved throughput.
The 221,429,760-byte/0.206223-GiB down-only sidecar is additional resident storage. Canonical scales remain resident for Prefill and 11 Decode fallback layers.
The 0.613196-ms idle value is an upper bound. The 0.101145732-ms 64-of-388 launch-amortization value is a proportional heuristic, not a measured or guaranteed saving.
Scale6 gate/up remains rejected and is excluded from palette v2 despite passing correctness gates.
Production runtime, dispatch, formal anchor, serial one-stream scheduling, and Prefill behavior remain unchanged.

selection_decision.decision: implement and formally measure Decode projection palette v2 as a new joint candidate
selection_decision.basis: three independent component pairs have strictly positive actual/stress rounds and planning arithmetic sums of 0.313080, 0.401048, and 0.490554 ms, while the down-only memory cost is bounded at 0.206223 GiB
not_authorized: claiming the arithmetic sum as joint or end-to-end timing
skipping the newly registered joint and end-to-end gates

next_priority.scope: joint QKV/Z FP8 streaming policy plus down-only scale6 sidecars for 53 eligible layers, with canonical fallback for 11 layers
next_priority.reason: Its component arithmetic median is 0.401048 ms versus the approximately 0.101-ms proportional 64-launch idle heuristic. Implement the joint route, then require same-process joint and three-process end-to-end evidence before any production decision.
